lessons_used: Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several unexpected winning updates performed better than predicted.

Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path new_flow, choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were helpful, winning in 6 of 11 tests (+9.3%, +5.6%, +4.3%, +4.4%, +3.1%, and +2.4%), while 5 showed no clear effect.
Sign-in wait info (sign_in wait_info) updates were helpful, winning in 2 of 3 tests (+3.0% and +7.3%), while 1 showed no clear effect.
Home wait info (home wait_info) changes were helpful in 5 of 13 tests (+4.2%, +3.9%, +2.6%, +2.7%, and +1.7%), while 8 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign and sign-in reordering (sign_in reorder) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests each.

candidates.score_note: Finish step already converts at 95.3%, but interactive finish flows have a strong history of success (6/11 wins, +2.6% avg).
